summary: Pruned 8 finished rows (7-9 Jul: Rhyme Time, Richard III talk, Lego Robotics, Regency Dancing, The Shires, White Skies in-store, Jack White listening party, Claremont Midsummer Night's Dream). Added 39 dated events, almost all from THREE NEVER-CHECKED VENUES a short hop away, which is this run's story: (1) OSO Arts Centre Barnes - its Ticketsolve XML feed exposes the whole season with exact ISO datetimes; added 13 shows incl. an Irish trad night (Ri Rua, 25 Jul), Cole Porter jazz, Soho Cello Quartet, pre-Fringe comedy (Matt Forde/Novellie 29 Jul, Stirling/Duker 30 Jul), Gyles Brandreth x2, half-term family show On Your Bike Baffo, Bring Your Own Baby comedy and The Little Mermaid panto (5-23 Dec, toddler-friendly 11:00/14:00 weekend slots); (2) Landmark Arts Centre Teddington (real listing path is /shows-and-events/) - 9 rows incl. Mark Thomas warm-up (24 Jul), folk (Rachel Croft 10 Sep, Roving Crows 1 Oct), AIDA, Autumn Art Fair and TIME by Luxmuralis immersive light installation (16-27 Sep); (3) Hampton Hill Theatre (needs a browser User-Agent) - 7 rows incl. Tim Vine (31 Jul), My Fair Lady, and three family Christmas runs (Robin Hood, Frozen JR, Ellie & Starlight's Christmas Adventure 12-24 Dec). Time-critical weekend finds: Eel Pie Island Artists Open Studios (11-12 Jul, rare public access to the island) and the Surrey Sculpture Society trail at Claremont (to 13 Jul). Also: Angus & Julia Stone folk church show (7 Aug, St John's via Banquet), Taste of the Caribbean festival (22 Aug, Fairfield Rec), new Ram Jam dates (3 Times 7 30 Jul, Andy Parsons WIP 10 Sep, John Hatcher 24 Sep, Never The Bride return 5 Nov), ExCellar Sunday Jazz (Alice Milburn 20 Sep) and Dorich House's free Undiminished exhibition (to 25 Jul). Stewart Lee 7-8 Sep RE-CONFIRMED: the Rose booking link is live again ('7-8 SEP 2026'), so the dates stand - only the 19:30 time still needs the Rose's own confirmation. Still-unpublished leads honestly held on watchlist rather than guessed: Kingston Carnival 2026, River Cultures Festival 2026, Playday 2026 (all still showing 2025 pages), Raise The Bar headliner, Speakeasy Brunch acts, Stanley Picker autumn term, Normansfield Theatre open days. Most library/Ram Jam finds this run were already in the dataset - dedupe prevented 15+ duplicates.
